query: SELECT sp.id, sp.name, ds.id as ds_id, ds.sourceUrl, ds.lastFetchStatus FROM sealedProducts sp LEFT JOIN dataSources ds ON ds.cardId = sp.id AND ds.productType = 'sealed_product' WHERE sp.name IN (SELECT name FROM sealedProducts GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) ORDER BY sp.name, sp.id;
